Everything is temporary on earth, from nights and days to seasons and rains. Some stays for the predicted amount of time, some can never be predicted. When it's summer we miss rain, when it's night, we prepare ourselves for the next day. It's a cycle, we always experience it turn after turn.
But when you are in love, we often fall for the bright sides and ignoring the darker once. In the beginning, we all just tend to win that person and think that you both can together handle the outcomes (difficulties in life) later no matter what it be.
And then when you are subjected to those darker sides of life, we sometimes feel like giving up on everything. Their smile, their love, your afforts taken to get them, their efforts put, sacrifices you both made, smiles that you together had, promises that you made to each other, etc. nothing matters at all. No, nothing really matters.
That's where your love is tested, that's when you tend to lose your feelings for the other. But when you consider it as a temporary phase of life, and see it as a forecoming tunnel that assures you the light after. You'll never come in a state to lose your feelings for the other, and their is no required struggle to get those feelings back on the same person. You wait. Because you know it's temperory.
But if you consider that darkness itself to be your life, you never wait for the light. You complain about the bad things, you come up with reasons to give up instead of focusing on the solution. You curb the urge to see and listen the life of other, you feel that they live in fantasy when they are all practical. You create distance and expect that person to maintain it.
And, and when you are out of all troubles in life, you stand there still and turn back to see how far you have come, you consider it like a burden on your chest. You made your partner to stand there far before the tunnel, you crossed it and now when your see them, it's obvious that you see them through that darkness. That is where you left them, you want them to be on your side now, but the darkness threatens you. You fear to fall in the same set of patterns. You can't imagine the miseries that you went through. Then you feel, you could've just waited for the bad times to end, instead of giving up on something that your struggled to win and call your own.
When you give up all your feelings on someone, you struggle to get it back. But if you've carried those feelings THROUGHOUT every subjected stages of your life, you can never fall out of love. It's like a gold being subjected to fire over and over only to lose its impurities.
Feelings are gold, impurities are bad moments, and fire is your struggles of life. Only if you carry your gold through it, you can know what is it in its purest form. But if you drop it for its impurities and come alone through the fire, you can only complain about your burns.
